{{Quote|She pulled my fat out of the fire when we were ambushed on that supply run through the Momansi Belt. I'd trust her with my life anytime.|[[Vin Nothos]], on Nera Dantels|<ref name="Rebellion" />}}
'''Momansi Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the belt was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ambush on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] supply convoy. The Alliance managed to escape with minimal losses thanks to the efforts of [[Nera Dantels]].<ref name="Rebellion" />
